instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Bonsai/Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not use the Blender Python console, Text editor scripts, Python, IfcOpenShell, shell commands, or any helper script/macro to directly generate or edit the deliverable file. Use only Bonsai/Blender native GUI tools, panels, menus, dialogs, object properties, and built-in IFC save/export commands. Community Workshop Office IFC. Start from a blank Bonsai/Blender project with no init_file inputs and no reference images. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc using Bonsai graphical IFC save/export controls. Create a community workshop shell with a small office, lobby, store, and WC. Model it as a single-storey rectangular BIM shell about 14 m by 8 m, with total height about 3.4 m and 1 IfcSlab. Create exactly 5 real IfcSpace objects named Workshop, Office, Store, WC, Lobby. Use at least 10 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, 5 IfcDoor elements, and 5 IfcWindow elements.  Use Bonsai's graphical material tools to create simple IfcMaterial entries named Concrete, Timber, Glass; they only need to be present in the exported IFC and may be assigned to appropriate walls, slabs, doors, or windows. For at least 5 of the doors or windows, use Bonsai's wall-based Door/Window workflow so the export includes corresponding opening, void, and fill relationships; exact host wall names and opening coordinates may vary. Create real IFC/BIM elements rather than ordinary Blender mesh placeholders or visual-only geometry. Do not use IfcBuildingElementProxy or IfcFurniture objects as substitutes for the required BIM elements. The exported IFC must use the IFC4 schema and have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects. Other coordinates, wall thicknesses, door/window styles, material assignments beyond the requested names, object type names, relationship nesting, property sets, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved IFC satisfies the stated model requirements.
